free_tier_limits.correction: Free for anyone to use; advised maximum 25 requests/second, and users expecting over 50,000 calls/day should contact NLM.

rate_limits.correction: Advised maximum 25 requests/second; this is a soft limit, with enforcement dependent on system load. Clients should handle X-RateLimit-Limit, Retry-After, and possible HTTP 503 responses.

notes: Current official index lists RxTerms v3 with July 2026 data, so no shutdown or migration was found. The curl request is documented-valid under the specified request-only example criterion. However, its supplied response snippet places extra-field data in the wrong array position; current docs place the ef object third and display values fourth.
